notes.title: Wishlist Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents On Steam Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699761/55971de1c28297a8bffc287c0e0e7f470898b428.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715020/Harrowed_World_Whats_Past_Is_Portents__Vampire_Visual_Novel/ ]‘Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents’[/url] is dark gothic vampire visual, intended to compliment ‘Harrowed World: Portents In Red’, the vampire RPG currently in development, by introducing you to factions and characters.

Step into a dark and unforgiving world where vampires pull the strings of humanity. You are not the hero, you are not the villain, you are nothing but a pawn in schemes that you cannot even begin to understand.

Become enthralled by the insidious immortals that have secretly dominated world affairs for centuries in this captivating narrative experience, elegantly presented in a gothic-style visual novel format.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715020/Harrowed_World_Whats_Past_Is_Portents__Vampire_Visual_Novel/ ]‘Harrowed World: What’s Past Is Portents’ is available to wishlist now on Steam and will launch for FREE later this year![/url]
